leadText: (Japanese: 果てしなき冒険 Endless Adventure) is the 77th and final chapter of the Pokémon RéBURST manga.
plainText:
(Japanese: 果てしなき冒険 Endless Adventure) is the 77th and final chapter of the Pokémon RéBURST manga.
==Plot==
 
==Major events==
Ryouga defeats Fraud.
Fraud exhausts the power of Arcades, turning into a statue.
Arcades' caretaker takes the statue of Fraud back.
Ryouga and his friends go on an another adventure to find a certain place where Pokémon can be freed from Burst Hearts.
